column1: # What each item costs to evaluate, for nix/ci/eval-each.sh --shard: <item><TAB><seconds><TAB><peak RSS MiB>.
# It changes only how evenly the shards are LOADED, never which items are evaluated: an item missing here gets
# RIME_EVAL_DEFAULT_SECONDS (45), a stale line only skews the balance, and --merge refuses any item no shard ran.
# Measured on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 (4 cores, 16 GB): the median seconds and the highest peak of Nix runs
# 44968969858, 44975989375 and 44990757301 (2026-11-22), light items 4 at a time, heavy ones (eval-heavy.txt) alone.
# nixosModules and overlays: ~1 s on the L16 (2026-11-22; no hosted figure, they only check the attrsets).
# Refresh from a run's "Evaluate shard" logs: every "OK <item>.drvPath <s>s <MiB>MiB" line is one row.
